about: Everyone who lives in the Phase 2 world. 'place' is a village (a 'village:' line in levels/world/) and how many rows and columns from its square, or a land's name and a row and column in that land's file (row 0, column 0 is its top-left corner). If that square isn't open ground, they stand on the nearest one that is. 'look' is a picture in sprites.PEOPLE_ART. 'role' (shop or smith) gives them a shop or an anvil. 'show_if' hides them until it's true. 'talk' is how they talk: phase2/dialogue.py explains it.

say: You found the way out of that cave! You ARE brave, {name}.
Here: the Dawn Stone, the first Light Stone. Six more are out there, one in every land.
Next, go north to Oakhollow in the Whispering Woods. Elder Oona has been waiting for a hero like you.
Hello, {name}! I'm Rosa, the guide of Home Meadow.
Walk with the ARROW keys. To talk to someone, walk into them, or press SPACE next to them.
Now listen. The Shadow King is stealing our light, and only the 7 Light Stones can wake the Portal so you can stop him.
The first one, the Dawn Stone, is mine to give. But first, show me you're brave: beat the cave under a Mine. Your first Mine is {first_mine}.
Hi again, {name}! Listen: the Shadow King is stealing our light, and only the 7 Light Stones can wake the Portal so you can stop him.
The first one, the Dawn Stone, is mine to give. But first, show me you're brave: beat the cave under a Mine. Your first Mine is {first_mine}.
Hi again, {name}!
What would you like to know?
SPACE does the thing where you stand: search a forest for berries, open a chest, climb down a Mine.
R attacks, in a fight and in a cave. G digs and opens chests in a cave. T chops wood, C crafts, F shoots arrows and E eats. Q shows your quests, and H shows every key.
Your first Mine is {first_mine}. Climb down with SPACE and find the EXIT door!
Beat that cave and come back to me, and I'll give you the Dawn Stone, the first of the 7 Light Stones.
{main_next}.
You have {relics} of the 7 Light Stones. Press Q any time to see your quests.
In Meadowbrook, Mabel's shop sells food, arrows, swords and armor for gold. Bram the blacksmith fixes swords.
You get gold from quests, from chests, and by selling wood. You have {gold} gold now.
Howdy, {name}! Winter is coming, and my woodpile is empty.
Could you bring me 10 wood? Chop trees in the forest with T.
Look at all that wood! Is it for me?
Any wood yet? I need 10, and you have {wood}.
My house will be warm all winter, thanks to you!
Thank you! Come back when you have 10 wood.
Thank you, {name}! Here's some gold for your trouble.
Waaah! My cat Whiskers ran away into the Whispering Woods!
Can you find her? She's orange, with a white tummy.
Did you find Whiskers? She ran north, into the woods.
WHISKERS! She came home! Thank you, thank you, {name}!
Here, take the gold from my piggy bank. And a snack!
Whiskers and I play every day now!
Thank you! Please hurry!
Hello, {name}! I'm Mabel. I buy and sell all sorts of things.
Welcome back! You have {gold} gold.
What can I do for you?
The forest feels calm again. Thank you, {name}!
Here is the Leaf Stone. Next, go to Old Finn in Lakeside, on the shore of the Great Lake. He knows where the Tide Stone is.
Rosa sent you? Then you must be {name}! I'm Oona, the elder of Oakhollow.
The Leaf Stone sleeps in my oak chest. But the monsters in the woods grow bolder every night.
Beat 4 of them, then climb the lookout tower to see the whole forest. Then the stone is yours!
The woods are still full of danger, {name}.
Next: {main_next}.
The woods are still full of danger, {name}.
Next: {main_next}.
The trees whisper your name now, {name}. They say: hero!
My grandmother told me about a pale boy who came out of the Portal, long ago. He only wanted to stand in the sun.
We were afraid of him, so we locked him out. Maybe the dark made him the Shadow King... and maybe we did.
The skeletons are gone! Ha! You fight like a true knight.
Take the Crown Stone. Next, cross the Icy River to Snowcap in the Frost Peaks, and find Hilda the Hunter.
Halt! Who goes there? ...A young hero! I'm Sir Rowan, the last knight of the old castle.
Skeletons took my castle. They shoot arrows from behind the broken walls.
Beat 3 Skeletons for me, and the Crown Stone of the old kings is yours.
Careful of their arrows, {name}! Hit them hard and fast.
Next: {main_next}.
These old walls are safe again, thanks to you, {name}.
Seven knights carried the seven Light Stones away, one to every land, so no one could open the Portal again.
I am the last of their order. Now the Stones have found a new keeper: you.
I'm Bram, the blacksmith. My anvil is always hot!
Back again, {name}?
What do you need?

choices.text: Forge a sword at your anvil

say: Clang! Clang! There, good as new.
{repair_problem}
Meow?
It's Whiskers! You show her the way home. She purrs and runs off to Pip.
A little orange cat. Her collar says: "I am WHISKERS. If you find me, take me home to Pip in Home Meadow."
Whiskers purrs and runs off home, to Pip.
Purrrr... Whiskers is happy to be home.
You did it! Grandpa would be proud.
Here's the Tide Stone. Now head north to the Old Ruins. A knight still guards them, they say... Sir Rowan.
Ahoy! You're the one gathering the Light Stones? I'm Finn. I've fished this lake for fifty years.
Long ago, my grandpa hid the Tide Stone at the bottom of a Mine by the lake.
Beat that cave, and I'll give you the stone I keep for the hero who does. Out on the water, look for bubbles: row over them and dive with SPACE!
That cave by the lake is a tricky one.
Next: {main_next}.
Ahoy! I'm Finn. I've fished this lake for fifty years.
Out on the water, look for bubbles. Row over them and dive with SPACE!
The fish bite best at sunrise, {name}.
Grandpa said that on clear nights you could see a cold light flicker on Portal Island. Like someone knocking.
These days it flickers every night. Whoever is behind that Portal is getting stronger.
The signal fire! I saw it from here. The ice is melting already...
Here is the Frost Stone. Now go south to the Sunscorch Desert. The Desert Gate opens for heroes of level 3. Find Juno in Sandwell.
Brrr! Welcome to Snowcap, {name}. I'm Hilda. Rosa sent word you were coming.
The Frost Stone is frozen in the ice of my lodge. Only a brave fire can melt it free.
Hunt 3 Frost Wolves, then climb a lookout in the Frost Peaks to light my signal. Up here, eat often and wear armor!
The wolves are fast. Stand your ground!
Next: {main_next}.
The wolves are fast. Stand your ground!
Next: {main_next}.
Brrr! Welcome to Snowcap, {name}. I'm Hilda.
Up here, eat often and wear armor. The cold bites, and so do the monsters!
Stay warm out there, {name}!
Wonderful! Here is the Moon Stone, the seventh Light Stone.
Now the Portal will wake. Build a boat, row to Portal Island and step through.
The Shadow King waits beyond. Only Sunfang, forged from 3 diamonds, can beat him. Good luck, {name}!
Ah, the young hero with six Light Stones! I am Eldon. I have lived in this murky swamp for 300 years.
I keep the last one, the Moon Stone. But Bog Lurkers have crept up to my hut.
Beat 3 Bog Lurkers. Hide in the tall reeds if you need to rest!
The Bog Lurkers are tough, but you're tougher.
Next: {main_next}.
The Portal on Portal Island is awake, {name}. Go!
Next: {main_next}.
Ah, a young knight. I am Eldon. I have lived in this murky swamp for 300 years.
The Shadow King waits beyond the Portal. Only Sunfang, forged from 3 diamonds, can beat him.
Climb a landmark with SPACE, and the land will show you its secrets.
Hot day, {name}! I trade food, arrows and armor.

choices.text: Let me see what you have

say: You got it back! Grandma would want you to have it.
Here's the Sun Stone! Only one more: Eldon the Wizard in Bogwater, in the Murk Swamp, has the last one.
You made it through the Desert Gate! I'm Juno. Grandma left me the Sun Stone to keep safe.
But I dropped it down a Mine, and it's full of monsters! Can you get it back?
Beat the cave under a Mine here in the desert, and the Sun Stone is yours.
Did you find the Sun Stone? Watch out for the lava down there!
Next: {main_next}.
Wow, a hero! Get to level 3 and the Desert Gate will let you in. Then come find me!
It's so hot here! Even the lizards wear hats.
